title: Etale neighbourhood of a maximal fibre degree point is finite locally free
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite]. Suppose $m\in\mathbb N$ bounds its finite fibre degrees [def-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-bound]. Let $s\in S$ have fibre degree $m$. There exist a scheme $T$, an etale morphism $\varphi:T\to S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] and a point $t\in T$ with $\varphi(t)=s$ such that the projection $X\times_S T\to T$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is finite locally free of degree $m$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free].

proof.text: The finite morphism from the fibre at s to Spec κ(s) has finite preimage of the unique point, so the fibre is a finite set (Scheme.Hom.finite_preimage_singleton). Its set of isolated points is therefore finite. Apply exists_etale_splits_off_quasiFinitePart to obtain an elementary etale neighbourhood (U,u), complementary opens W,V in the pullback, a finite map V → U, and empty W fibre at u. Transfer finiteness of the scheme fibre to the set-theoretic fibre using f.fiberHomeo s. The locally quasi-finite hypothesis is not needed by this step: the bound already assumes every fibre finite, and local finite presentation supplies local finite type.

proof.text: The pullback projection g is flat and locally of finite presentation by the Mathlib base-change instances. The open inclusion V.ι has both properties, and composition preserves them. Together with the supplied finiteness, this gives (V.ι ≫ g).IsFiniteLocallyFree directly from its definition.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RY (lemma-stratify-flat-fp-lqf-universally-bounded), line 12761, proof, second paragraph ('Since V -> U is finite, flat, and locally of finite presentation, we see that V -> U is finite locally free, see Morphisms, Lemma 02KB')

proof.text: The proved private finite_fiber_degree_of_pullback applies isPullback_fiberToSpecResidueField_of_isPullback to any cartesian square, transfers finiteness by base-change stability, and compares sections by the proved source-library nonempty_algEquiv_tensorProduct_Γ_of_isPullback. Module.finrank_baseChange then identifies the degrees. The proved private fiberDegree_add_of_finite_fiber applies the source-library fiberDegree_of_isCompl to the finite fibre over its residue field, compares degree there with finrankΓ using fiberDegree_eq_finrankΓ, and transports both summands using fiberRestrictIso and finrankΓ_eq_of_iso. Since the W fibre at u is empty, its degree is zero; additivity and the base-change comparison give degree m for V at u. Apply finiteLocallyFree_fiberDimension_isLocallyConstant and select its degree-m open O, which contains u. Restrict g to O. The preimages W′,V′ remain complementary. Pullback pasting and the canonical pullback isomorphisms identify V′ → O with the degree-m restriction of V → U; thus V′ → O is finite of constant degree m.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RY (lemma-stratify-flat-fp-lqf-universally-bounded), line 12761, proof, second paragraph ('After shrinking U ... we may assume V -> U is finite locally free of some degree d, see Morphisms, Lemma 04MH. As u -> s and W_u is empty we see that d = n')

proof.text: For each point of O the full fibre is finite and has degree at most m, by the proved private base-change comparison. Its degree is the sum of the W′ and V′ degrees, by the proved private additivity helper. Since the V′ degree is m, arithmetic forces the W′ degree to be zero. The private finite_fiber_of_clopen proves this fibre finite using the closed immersion of the complementary open and fiberRestrictIso. The private isEmpty_fiber_of_finite_degree_zero obtains finite-dimensional sections from the finite ring map; Module.finrank_zero_iff makes these sections the zero ring, whose spectrum is empty. Therefore every W′ fibre is empty. Any point of W′ would give a point of its fibre over its image via asFiber, so W′ is empty and V′ is top. Its inclusion is an isomorphism; cancel it to obtain finiteness and constant degree m for the whole restricted projection. Pullback pasting identifies this projection with pullback.snd f (O.ι ≫ φ). The composite O.ι ≫ φ is etale and the point u still maps to s. This constructs the required neighbourhood, including m=0. All five private helpers are completely proved in Lean; no new statement with sorry is introduced.

lean.statement: theorem exists_etale_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfDegree_of_maximal_fiber_degree {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [IsSeparated f] (h_lqf : IsLocallyQuasiFinite f) (m : ℕ) (hm : BoundsFiberDegrees f m) (s : S) (hs : (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s).finrankΓ = m) : ∃ (T : Scheme.{u}) (φ : T ⟶ S) (t : T), Etale φ ∧ φ t = s ∧ (pullback.snd f φ).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfDegree m
